name: NURS 5103
title: Pharmacology of Pain and Analgesia
description: This course reviews processes underlying functional and pathological pain states, exploring the effects and limitations of pharmacotherapies currently used to treat pain. Particular emphases placed on the concept of individualized care and non-opioid pain interventions.
requirement_description: Recommended Preparation: Background in nursing or other health or allied health training recommended but not required.
